title: 5.5.1 Joints: Distance, Hinge, Slider
description: Connect two sprites with different joint types. See how each joint constrains motion.

steps.title: DistanceJoint
steps.instructions: new DistanceJoint(a, b) keeps two sprites at a fixed distance, like an invisible rigid bar.
hints: Use it for chains, ropes, tethers.

steps.title: HingeJoint
steps.instructions: new HingeJoint(a, b) pins them at a point but lets them rotate freely — door hinges, pendulums, ragdolls.

steps.title: SliderJoint
steps.instructions: new SliderJoint(a, b) lets them only translate along one axis — pistons, elevators, sliding drawers.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instructions: The starter sketch shows all three side by side. Add a second DistanceJoint to form a triangle of sprites.
